evals.name: item-by-item-from-file
evals.prompt: Verify PR #220; its issue has two acceptance items.
evals.expected_output: Runs `fsd-qa prep 220`, then each item with `fsd-qa run <k>` exactly as written, takes the exit from the file (an `__EXIT=0` printed by the program does not count), marks verdicts and publishes with `fsd-qa finish --entrega <json>`. Does NOT skip an item and does NOT read the exit from the screen.

evals.name: refuses-without-closes
evals.prompt: Verify PR #230, whose body has no "Closes #n".
evals.expected_output: `fsd-qa prep` refuses: tells the PR author with `fsd-diga` that the PR needs `Closes #<issue>`. Does NOT invent the acceptance.

evals.name: new-commit-new-run
evals.prompt: You verified #220 at a1b2c3d; Stuart pushed a fix.
evals.expected_output: Runs a new verification at the new head (`fsd-qa prep 220`). Never reuses verdicts of the old commit.

evals.name: build-fails
evals.prompt: Verify PR #220; `fsd-qa prep 220` says BUILD FALHOU.
evals.expected_output: Runs `fsd-qa finish --entrega <json>` with verdict `fail`: the report shows the build failure as the only item and requests changes. Does NOT run the acceptance items on a broken build and does NOT approve.

evals.name: nonzero-pass-needs-reason
evals.prompt: Item 2 of #220 expects the command to refuse with exit 1, and it did.
evals.expected_output: Marks PASS with the expected result written (`fsd-qa verdict 2 PASS "refuses with exit 1"`), because a PASS with a non-zero exit needs the reason. Never marks PASS on a non-zero exit without saying why it is right.
